mapper.sql: b.id, b.batch_name, b.term, b.check_type, b.scope_building, b.start_date, b.end_date, b.publish_date, b.criteria_json, b.status, b.note, b.created_by, b.created_at, b.updated_at, b.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.real_name, ''), c.nickname, c.username) AS created_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_inspection i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS inspection_count, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(i.score), 2) FROM community_inspection i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS avg_score
FROM community_batch b LEFT JOIN users c ON c.id = b.created_by

sql.if: AND (b.batch_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.note LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_batch (batch_name, term, check_type, scope_building, start_date, end_date, publish_date, criteria_json, status, note, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{batchName}, #{term}, #{checkType}, #{scopeBuilding}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{publishDate}, #{criteriaJson}, #{status}, #{note}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE b.deleted = 0
ORDER BY b.status ASC, b.start_date DESC, b.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE community_batch SET batch_name = #{batch.batchName}, term = #{batch.term}, check_type = #{batch.checkType}, scope_building = #{batch.scopeBuilding}, start_date = #{batch.startDate}, end_date = #{batch.endDate}, criteria_json = #{batch.criteriaJson}, status = #{batch.status}, note = #{batch.note}, publish_date = #{batch.publishDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{batch.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT b.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM community_batch b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.term = #{term} GROUP BY b.status ORDER BY b.status

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'draft' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draft, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'checking' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checking, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'scored' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scored, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'published' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS published, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished FROM community_batch b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.term = #{term}
